thread:
elaine: Quick kickoff for Nimbus Labs hardware preview (NDA signed). We have rack access next week and Nimbus is asking for a short marketplace listing after a successful pilot. Need owners for benchmarks, infra access, telemetry, and marketplace assets. Volunteers? Onboarding doc: https://drive.redwood/example-nimbus-onboard :nerd_face:

sam: I can take benchmarks. Plan: 3x3 matrix — batch sizes [1,8,32] x quant profiles [fp16,int8/q4] x seq lengths [512,2048]. Will need prompt set + eval metrics from product. Also will run KV-cache stress tests.

ryan: Infra update: provisioned dedicated EAP pool (tag: nimbus-eap). Jumpbox + base container image pushed. Need SSH pubkeys + partner allowed IP ranges. Can start bring-up tomorrow.

katie: Marketplace & comms: drafting listing (short blurb, bullets, compliance checklist). We should not publish until perf & privacy checks clear. Timeline: assets (logo, short desc, contact) by next Tue to hit marketplace review.

ben: I'll assemble the prompt set and evaluation rubric. Proposed scorecard: p95 latency (ms), median tokens/sec, peak GPU memory (GB), 99th failure rate, quality delta vs baseline. Baseline model: redwood/redwood-13b-quant (swap per partner).

lab-bot: bench-runner started: run-id=nimbus-2801122334-smoke. Logs -> s3://redwood-eap/nimbus/2801122334/logs.

elaine: Owners: @sam benchmarks, @ryan infra, @katie marketplace, @ben prompts. I'll request Nimbus's logo and CIDR list. Confirmed NDA allows partner to see raw telemetry pre-publication (legal ok with embargo conditions).

sam: Starting smoke now — will post summary. Smoke command for reproducibility:

```
python run_bench.py --model redwood/redwood-13b-quant \
  --prompts s3://redwood-evals/nimbus/smoke_prompts.jsonl \
  --batch 8 --seq_len 512 --quant q4 \
  --out s3://redwood-eap/nimbus/2801122334/results.csv
```

sam: smoke snapshot:
```
[INFO] 2026-03-26 09:12:01 - avg_latency_ms: 42.7
[INFO] 2026-03-26 09:12:01 - tokens_per_sec: 620
[WARN] 2026-03-26 09:12:05 - kv-miss spikes under synthetic workload (investigating)
```

ryan: Jumpbox creds in 1Password: item nimbus-eap-jumpbox. Opened firewall for partner CIDR 198.51.100.0/24 per their security contact.

katie: :eyes: Drafting marketplace copy and a legal checklist for NDA-embargo language. Elaine, can you ask Nimbus for a 300px SVG logo and a 1-paragraph partner quote?

ben: Uploaded prompt set + expected output checks to onboarding doc. Suggest gating public announcement until: (1) benchmarks pass stability (7-day run) and (2) partner sign-off on the writeup.

elaine: Agreed. Can we aim for an initial run-by EOD Fri for a smoke summary, then a 7-day stability run next week? I'll schedule a 30m sync Thu 11am PT. Ping if blocked. :party_parrot:

sam: :thumbsup: Extended tests running overnight, will post aggregated CSV and a PR with run notes tomorrow AM.

lab-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-eap/nimbus/2801122334/bench-results-summary.csv

ryan: If anyone needs additional network setup or PVs, DM me.

katie: Noted. I'll put the marketplace draft in the marketing drive and tag everyone for review.

elaine: Thanks team — will follow up after Thu sync with checklist and announcement cadence. If Nimbus wants a joint blog we'll coordinate dates after stability sign-off
